why: Relaunch the app and open any project: is the violet Assistant capsule pinned first in its tabs and clearly different from session tabs? Click it, then Status update in its pane: does it start fresh on a project-only sweep?
Relaunch: click a project tab or card, does it open its hub in Tasks? Click a pane's title, does it open that session alone with its terminal?

Relaunch: in a project session press Cmd-G (grid), Cmd-G again (back to that session with its tabs); from the all-projects grid Cmd-G drops into the focused pane's project. Does the pane-header grid icon flip to a single-rectangle 'back' button in the grid?
